objective: Add current-main contract coverage for the already registered Pexels, Pixabay and Pexafy visual acquisition adapters without replacing current provider implementations or changing production routing defaults.

security.notes: Tests use mocked HTTP and synthetic response metadata. They do not embed credentials or claim live provider qualification. Provider results remain candidates until asset bytes, licence/attribution, hash, CAS and downstream F07 requirements are satisfied.
